# Tables and Figures

<!-- Layout mirrors studies/land_tenure/narrative/sections/98_tables_and_figures.Rmd.
     Tables are built by scripts/exhibit_helpers_tables.R; figures by
     scripts/101_exhibit_figures.R into output/figures/. See scripts/README.md.
     Exhibit titles are markdown headings (not flextable captions) so they appear in the
     Word navigation pane. Landscape exhibits are grouped into ONE section: emitting
     sec_landscape() then sec_portrait() back to back creates an empty portrait section,
     which Word renders as a blank page. A section's properties apply to the content
     BEFORE it: sec_portrait() closes a portrait run, sec_landscape() closes a landscape run.

     NONE OF THE ft_*() BUILDERS BELOW EXIST YET. This file is the target shape, written
     2026-08-07 from the v000 draft's exhibit list. The frozen Word tables were deliberately
     NOT pasted in: every number the paper prints comes from the pipeline. The v000 values
     are preserved in narrative/v000_...docx and, cell by cell, in
     narrative/diagnostics/verification_reference_2026-08-07.json.

     FIGURE MAPPING was recovered on 2026-08-07 by matching the draft's embedded images
     (Word downsampled them, so md5 does not match) against output/figures/ on exact aspect
     ratio plus image content. Recorded in the migration log. -->

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sec_portrait()
```
